faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad is 15th August 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M. Tech degree in relevant engineering or biosciences fields with 60% marks, or an M. Sc. degree with fellowships or a year of research experience to be eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their academic merit, followed by an online interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the type of job offered?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow positions at IIT Hyderabad are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow will be the standard JRF amount plus HRA (House Rent Allowance).

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxations for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for detailed information.
